content: ‘The examinations were conducted in a transparent manner and were completely peaceful,’ Rahul Pandve, Deputy Commissioner of Yadgir, told The Hindu.

title: Over 26,000 government primary schools shut in U.P. after BJP came to power: Akhilesh Yadav
content: The highest number of closures took place in Lakhimpur Kheri, where 758 schools were shut, followed by Sitapur (650) and Prayagraj (638). In Gorakhpur, the home district of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, around 500 primary schools were closed, says Akhilesh Yadav

title: Tata Trusts is moving towards building institutions, from just funding projects, says its Chairman, Noel Tata
content: “The founders left their shares in the companies to the Trusts with one message: do good for India. They never said to become the biggest company. The companies exist to serve India and improve the quality of life,” says Mr. Tata

title: Chittoor police book 771 for drunk driving, collect ₹77.10 lakh in fines
content: Superintendent of Police says drunk driving is not merely a traffic violation but also a reckless act that could result in irreversible tragedies for families

title: Gescom chairman directs officials to ensure uninterrupted power supply
content: The chairman reviewed transformer repair centre, Hampi power network, solar project and priority government schemes in Hosapete region.

title: Centre’s additional tax devolution will boost Andhra Pradesh’s development, says Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu
content: The ₹4,597 crore additional funds will enable the government to expedite several ongoing projects and strengthen its efforts to achieve long-term development goals, he says

content: Coming from a modest background, Rakesh attributed his success to the unwavering support and sacrifices of his parents.

title: Communist Party of India to cover 100 villages in Kalaburagi as part of nation-wide padayatra
content: In Kalaburagi district, the padayatra will be held at Jewargi, Aland and Yadrami taluks, covering around 100 villages.

content: Nine individuals, including six Keralites and three natives of Tamil Nadu, have been arrested by the Customs

content: Jairam Ramesh alleges the National Security Act was invoked against Pranab Doley after he secured bail, calling it an attempt to suppress democratic dissent

content: Court cautions the Joint Directors of Urban Affairs and Secretaries of the Local Self-Government Institutions against strict action if violations continued

content: Payments for Mundakan and Puncha harvests remain pending for months; farmers plan protest meet on August 5

content: Tirthahalli MLA Araga Jnanendra, who visited the spot, said those affected were workers who had come from different parts of the State in search of employment

content: The Bill treats a federation as a higher-level body responsible for managing infrastructure shared by multiple apartment associations

title: YouTube terminates Delhi slum-dweller’s page following overnight success, social media protests
content: While YouTube has not yet issued any official clarification, attempts to access Mohammad Irfan’s page ‘Main Irfan’ display a message stating that “this account has been terminated for violating Google’s Terms of Service”.

content: Puducherry Lieutenant Governor K. Kailashnathan said youth can contribute to nation-building only if they remain physically strong, mentally sound and emotionally resilient

title: Census 2027 self-enumeration begins in Assam, suspended in two flood-hit districts
content: According to the last Census in 2011, Assam had a total population of 3.12 crore, while the complete draft of the National Register of Citizens in August 2019 recorded 3.3 crore people

title: Digging up newly-tarred roads for water supply works: Kerala government constitutes monitoring committee for Thiruvananthapuram city
content: Move comes months after the Kerala State Human Rights Commission issued directives in this regard to the Water Resources department and the Kerala Water Authority

title: NGT impleads HPCL, fuel outlet dealer in Kovilambakkam groundwater contamination case
content: The case was initiated by the NGT based on a news report which highlighted residents' concerns over petrol allegedly mixing with groundwater in the locality

title: Drugs-free youth crucial for developed India, says PM Modi, launches campaign
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi says as India has set the goal of becoming a developed country, it is essential for the youth to remain physically and mentally fit, and therefore stay away from drug abuse

title: 'In map of India, our North East is missing': Medallist Lovlina felt ‘hurt’ in Glasgow
content: Lovlina Borgohain said she felt hurt after noticing India’s Northeast was missing from a map at a Glasgow restaurant during a celebratory dinner. The Assam boxer raised the issue with management, who acknowledged the mistake and promised to correct it. BFI president Ajay Singh said there was no confrontation, describing the incident as an aberration.

title: 'Job loss, financial stress': Pune family of 3 dies by 'suicide'; note found
content: A family of three in Pimpri allegedly attempted suicide by inhaling poisonous fumes. The father died at the scene, and his wife and daughter later succumbed to their injuries. Financial struggles and job loss were cited as reasons for the tragic incident. Police recovered a note detailing their severe financial crisis. Investigations are ongoing, and bodies have been sent for post-mortem.

title: Jeff Bezos warns Mamdani on NYC taxes, slams wasteful spending
content: Jeff Bezos commented on New York City's proposed pied-à-terre tax. He suggested that aggressive tax increases could negatively impact tourism and competitiveness. Bezos also criticized targeting individuals, calling it a villain strategy. He argued that government spending inefficiencies are a greater concern than taxation. Bezos previously criticized the city's public school spending and economic policies.

title: ‘Culture of Congress leaders’: BJP minister slams Nana Patole feet-washing video
content: A video shows Nana Patole supporters washing his feet during Gurupurnima celebrations. Maharashtra revenue minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule criticized this Congress party practice. Bawankule stated it is the culture of Congress leaders to indulge in such acts. He questioned why they engage in practices that only bring criticism. The incident has drawn attention and political criticism on social media.

title: Can BJP crack Punjab? Inside its strategy to challenge AAP and Congress in 2027
content: The BJP is implementing a detailed strategy to gain ground in Punjab. Prime Minister Modi's visits and outreach to the Ravidassia community are key. The party is acquiring prominent leaders from rival parties to strengthen its organization. New state leadership aims to connect with Sikh voters and expand rural reach. The BJP is also attacking rivals while promising development and prosperity.

title: Nuclear plants, Gaza craters: Google pulls AI tool from Google Earth in 24 hours
content: Google has removed its new AI image generation feature from Google Earth. This action followed immediate concerns raised by researchers about disinformation risks. Experts warned the tool could easily create convincing fake satellite imagery for public deception. Google stated they are implementing stronger safeguards while pausing the feature. The company noted generated images were watermarked as AI-created.

title: South Dakota angler breaks 56-year pumpkinseed record with 1lb catch
content: A routine fishing trip on South Dakota's Wall Lake turned into a record-breaking moment for teenager Jack Backman after he caught a one-pound pumpkinseed, setting a new state record. Thinking he had hooked a crappie, Backman was surprised to discover the rare catch. The fish beat a 12-ounce state record that had stood since 1970.

title: Engineers link wells beneath Oregon volcano to unlock 24/7 clean power
content: Mazama Energy connected two deep wells reaching 629 degrees Fahrenheit. This marks the world's hottest enhanced geothermal system ever built. The company plans three more wells in 2026 targeting hotter rock. This project aims to unlock superhot rock for cleaner energy production. Geothermal energy could become a significant player in the clean energy mix.

title: After AGI division layoffs and Lab shutdown, Amazon is refocusing its AI strategy
content: Amazon's AI division is undergoing significant restructuring and consolidation.  Several flagship in-house models are being phased out and specialized research groups are closing.  Compute power and technical staff are now focused on a single frontier model initiative.  This strategic shift aims to maintain pace with industry rivals and evolving customer needs.  Renowned AI roboticist Pieter Abbeel will lead this new frontier model research effort.

title: Built for tomorrow's wars: How India's 350kg turbojet reshapes warfare
content: DRDO's indigenous engine can power next-generation cruise missiles, jet-powered kamikaze drones; technology mastered by only a handful of nations

title: Gurgaon MNC employee dies by suicide, son records video as mother screams for help
content: A Gurugram man was found hanging after his wife sought a divorce. His seven-year-old son reportedly recorded a video of the incident. The deceased's sister alleges foul play and disputes the suicide claim. Police have detained the wife and are investigating the circumstances thoroughly. The post-mortem report is awaited to determine the exact cause of death.

title: Bodies of Nirmal Purja, 9 climbers recovered after Broad Peak avalanche in PoK
content: Ten climbers, including Nirmal Purja, died in a Broad Peak avalanche. Search efforts continue for the remaining bodies after the incident. Rescuers recovered three bodies on Friday, facing weather disruptions. The Alpine Club of Pakistan confirmed the immeasurable loss to mountaineering. This tragedy highlights the extreme risks faced in high-altitude expeditions.

title: 'Love song and a murder': Video captures woman's final moments with ex-husband
content: An Instagram reel showed a man with his ex-wife before her alleged murder. Police stated the divorced husband called her for a reconciliation meeting. He reportedly attacked her with a sharp weapon and buried her body. A goatherd heard screams and alerted villagers, leading to the arrest. The body was exhumed for a post-mortem examination.

title: New stock market timings from August 3: What has changed?
content: Starting August 3, Sebi will implement a new Closing Auction Session for F&O stocks. This session will determine the official closing price after regular trading concludes. Trading hours in the equity derivatives segment will also extend by ten minutes. The pre-open session has been revised with new order entry and matching times. These changes aim for a fairer and more transparent closing price discovery.

title: CJP offers legal aid to Noida teen booked over 'abusive' video on PM Modi
content: Ratna Singh of Cockroach Janta Party spoke with the mother of a Noida teenager.  The mother is upset that the FIR remains active despite an apology video.  The party assured no legal action and offered full support to the teenager.  The teenager's mother thanked Prime Minister Modi for his forgiveness gesture.  She also requested the Prime Minister to help secure her daughter's future.

title: 'Ready to face death': Pappu Yadav unfazed by FIR over Ram Temple 'skit'
content: Pappu Yadav remains defiant after police filed a case against him and other opposition leaders.  The FIR stems from a Parliament skit which depicted alleged theft of Ram Temple donations.  Yadav stated he is ready to face death to protect people's faith and religious sentiments.  Varanasi Police registered the case following a complaint by a religious leader.  Another complaint was filed against the MP in the national capital.

title: 'Should apologise': CPM slams Kerala CM over attending events during rain crisis
content: CPM leaders criticized Kerala Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan for attending a private function. They stated his visit was inappropriate while thousands faced rain-related disasters across the state. Senior CPM leaders compared the Chief Minister's actions to Nero fiddling while Rome burned. They urged the Chief Minister to focus on disaster relief efforts. Kerala Tourism Minister P.C. Vishnunadh stated the focus should be on relief.

title: 'Mekedatu project permanent solution': Shivakumar on Cauvery water dispute
content: Karnataka chief minister DK Shivakumar views the Mekedatu dam project as a permanent solution.  He stated the Supreme Court and central government have already responded to the proposal.  Shivakumar urged all stakeholders to move forward without further delays or wasting time.  This project aims to bring both states to the table for amicable discussions.  The Cauvery water dispute centers on sharing river waters during periods of low rainfall.

title: 'PM gave her jeevandaan': Noida teen's mother thanks Modi, wants him to 'adopt her'
content: The mother of a Noida teenager thanked Prime Minister Modi for forgiving her daughter's protest remarks. She stated the Prime Minister's forgiveness was a birthday gift and a new lease of life. The mother appealed for the withdrawal of the FIR, claiming her daughter's age was incorrectly stated. She requested stricter social media controls for minors and their exclusion from protests.

title: 'Took my jewellery': Actor Aditi Sharma accuses husband, in-laws of domestic abuse
content: Television actress Aditi Sharma has filed a domestic violence complaint against her husband and his family. An FIR was registered at Mumbai's Goregaon Police Station on July thirty-first. The actress alleged domestic abuse by her husband and his family members. Police have launched an investigation and are recording statements from all parties. Further action will be taken after evidence collection and examination.

title: Huge blow! Jasprit Bumrah ruled out of Sri Lanka Tests | Exclusive
content: Star bowler Jasprit Bumrah will miss the upcoming Test series against Sri Lanka. He continues to feel discomfort in his left knee after an initial assessment. Stakeholders have decided it is not safe to push him back into cricket. A full recovery is now the primary focus for the Indian team. The two-Test series is scheduled to begin on August 15.

title: MHT CET 2026 CAP round 1 seat allotment result out today: Check steps to download
content: Maharashtra CET Cell releases MHT CET 2026 CAP Round 1 seat allotment today. Candidates can check their engineering course allotment status online using login credentials. Accepted candidates must report to their institutes between August 3 and August 5. Vacant seats for CAP Round 2 will be displayed on August 6. Option entry for the second round will commence from August 7 to August 9.

title: 'Buy police uniforms, head to Jantar Mantar': Inside 'Pakistan-linked' terror plot
content: West Bengal Police STF arrested Arpita Sarkar, girlfriend of suspected terrorist Hamim Mondal.  Investigators are probing their alleged plan to create disturbances at Jantar Mantar.  Hamim was reportedly working under instructions from Pakistani handlers via social media.  Arpita is also suspected of involvement in a honey-trap network targeting influential people.  The investigation is ongoing, and more arrests are anticipated in the coming days.

title: Market recap: Top-10 firms add Rs 2.51 lakh crore; Bajaj Finance biggest winner
content: India's largest listed firms saw market value increase by Rs 2.51 lakh crore last week. Nine of the top ten most-valued companies experienced valuation gains on Dalal Street. Bajaj Finance led the surge after reporting strong June-quarter earnings, while Hindustan Unilever declined. The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty indices climbed significantly, reflecting positive market sentiment. Easing crude oil prices and renewed foreign investor buying boosted risk appetite.

title: 8 dead as heavy rain wreaks havoc, triggers landslides, floods across Kerala
content: Kerala faces severe rain and flooding, resulting in at least eight fatalities. Landslides and inundation have caused widespread damage across several districts. Rescue operations are underway for stranded residents and missing fishermen. Authorities have opened relief camps and issued alerts for continuing rainfall. Tourist destinations remain temporarily closed due to the ongoing adverse weather conditions.

title: RBI deposit rules: Differential rates, daily disclosures changes explained
content: The Reserve Bank of India has revised rules for bulk deposits, effective October 2026. Banks can now offer differential interest rates based on liquidity risk under the LCR framework. This move aligns deposit pricing with revised LCR guidelines for better asset-liability management. Mandatory daily public disclosure of bulk deposit rates will enhance transparency for customers. However, uniform rates will continue for similarly placed depositors across all branches.

title: 150-year-overdue library book returned in Australia; racks up Rs 16 lakh 'late fee'
content: A library received a book returned after 150 years overdue.  The calculated late fee reached approximately twenty-eight thousand Australian dollars.  This rare book was discovered during home renovations and was damaged.  It was borrowed by a local resident's great-great-grandfather in the 1870s.  The book will now join the library's local history collection.

title: When a district in Florida's Everglades used robot rabbits to eliminate Burmese pythons
content: Florida is employing AI-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons. These solar-powered decoys mimic prey using heat and scent to lure snakes. When a python is detected, officials are alerted to remove the invasive species. This technology complements the annual Python Challenge, which has removed thousands of snakes. These efforts aim to control the python population impacting native wildlife.

title: Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana: How workers can avail Rs 1.6 lakh housing aid
content: In Gujarat, registered construction workers have the opportunity to benefit from financial support aimed at housing through the Shree Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana. To qualify, applicants must have been registered with the welfare board for a minimum of two years. Following the acquisition of an e-Nirman Card and house allotment, they can submit their applications. Those approved will receive ₹1.6 lakh to assist in home ownership.

title: Aarti's mother Sujatha Vijayakumar's advice to Ravi Mohan: 'be a father like Vijay'
content: Sujatha Vijayakumar urged Ravi Mohan to be a better father to his sons. She rejected his allegations and presented documents supporting her family's claims. The producer stated that Ravi had not cooperated with passport signings for the children. She also announced a memorial event for filmmakers Bharathiraja and K. Bhagyaraj. The ongoing court case between Ravi Mohan and Aarti remains pending.

title: FPIs return to India: Rs 20,200 cr injected into equities after months of selling
content: Foreign portfolio investors returned to Indian equities in July after four months of outflows. They invested twenty thousand two hundred crore rupees in stocks during July. This renewed interest stems from attractive valuations and improving corporate earnings. Foreign investors also showed strong interest in the Indian debt market during July. Overseas developments and domestic events will guide future investment directions.

title: Dalal Street outlook: RBI policy, earnings and other cues to drive market this week
content: The stock market faces a crucial week with key domestic and global events. The Reserve Bank of India's interest rate decision is a major focus for investors. Geopolitical developments in West Asia and crude oil prices will also influence sentiment. Several large companies are set to announce their quarterly earnings results. Foreign investors turned net buyers in July, supporting market confidence.

title: Bobby Fischer: The champion America summoned, and Iceland sheltered
content: Henry Kissinger once urged Bobby Fischer to face the Soviets. It was a small island, not his homeland, that gave him a resting place. In the second column of The Grandmaster View, India's 93rd Grandmaster Aarav Dengla traces Fischer's journey from Cold War hero to exiled genius. his revolutionary impact on chess, the tragedy of his later years, and why the country that embraced him in death offered the sense of belonging that his own homeland ultimately could not.

title: Indian diaspora in China flags anti-India social media posts, visa curbs
content: Indian diaspora members voiced concerns over anti-India content and visa issues.  Ambassador Vikram Doraiswami assured actions were being taken to address these matters.  Visa requirements for Chinese citizens traveling to India will be eased soon.  The embassy plans to establish a legal assistance framework for professionals.  Cultural outreach programs will also be expanded to promote Indian diversity.

title: 'If visibility is reason, then blue jersey should never be worn again': Sreejesh
content: The Indian men's and women's teams will wear saffron jerseys as their primary kit at the World Cup, which begins on August 15 in the Netherlands and Belgium. The move has drawn criticism from several former India captains. While Sreejesh said he has no problem with the jersey colour changing, he questioned the explanation that blue jerseys are difficult to see on blue hockey turfs.

title: "Want Sheikh Hasina To Return, Remove Ban On Her Party": Taslima Nasreen
content: "The ouster of Awami League leader Sheikh Hasina in the way it happened was wrong. It was anti-democratic," Taslima Nasreen said

title: 72 Dead As Record 60,000 Migrants Surge Into Spain's Ceuta
content: Most of the estimated 60,000 people who rushed into Spain's north African territory have returned to Morocco since the territory's largest mass migrant crossing.

title: 'Don't Befriend Kafirs': Pak General Spews Religious Hate, Targets India
content: Pakistan's Director General ISPR, Lieutenant General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry, also took a dig at Afghanistan over its ties with India.

title: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja's Body Recovered Days After Avalanche Killed Crew
content: The avalanche struck on Thursday, cutting off contact with the international expedition led by Purja, a 43-year-old British-Nepali climber, on Broad Peak.

content: Vinod had studied Computer Science at IIM Ahmedabad, while Sirja worked as a coordinator at a school.

title: Tiger Grabs Madhya Pradesh Woman By Head, Drags Her For 300 Metres. She Dies
content: Sugni Bai Dhurve was sleeping in a hut when a big cat entered the village, about 80 km from the district headquarters, around 1.30 am, grabbed her by the head and dragged her away.

title: IIT Guwahati Student Drowns, Another Injured After Falling Into Brahmaputra
content: The two girls went outside the IIT campus to spend some time by the riverside when they accidentally slipped and fell into the river.

title: Alliance University Launches Quantum AI School With 8-Qubit Computing Centre
content: The new campus has been set up as an interdisciplinary hub that brings together quantum computing, artificial intelligence (AI), robotics and technology entrepreneurship under one roof.

title: Gen Z Men Are Going Bald Early. Start-Ups See A Billion-Dollar Opportunity
content: India's hair loss treatment segment was worth close to $282 million in 2024 and is on track to more than double, past $539 million, within the decade.

title: 5 Dead, 41 Missing After Ferry Carrying 271 Catches Fire In Indonesia
content: At least five people were killed and 41 remain missing after a ferry carrying 271 passengers and crew caught fire off Indonesia's Madura Island on Sunday, authorities said.

title: Floodwater In House, Medals On Wall: Gujarat Boy's Dream Bigger Than Challenges
content: Between Friday and Saturday, Navsari in Gujarat has recorded over 400 mm rainfall in 24 hours, in what was a second spell of showers within a week.

title: IIT Guwahati Student Drowns In Brahmaputra After "Accidental" Fall, Another Rescued
content: According to police sources, two IIT Guwahati students had gone outside the campus to spend some time by the riverside when they accidentally slipped and fell into the river.

title: "He Gave Jeevandaan By Forgiving Her": Mother Of Girl Who Abused PM Modi
content: PM Modi had earlier appealed for restraint and forgiveness over the abusive slogans directed at him during student protests.

title: Mayur Vihar To AIIMS In 20 Minutes: Delhi's Barapullah Corridor To Open Soon
content: The 3.5-km-long Barapullah Phase-3 elevated corridor is expected to open this month after facing a delay of nearly nine years.

title: Wildfires On Over 250,000 Acres Across Washington State Prompt Evacuations
content: Wildfires across more than a quarter of a million acres in Washington state have prompted widespread evacuations and power outages in the Spokane area, state officials said on Saturday evening.

content: Indian diaspora in China raises concerns on abusive content and visa restrictions at embassy Open House

content: According to preliminary information, the boy allegedly swallowed a small plastic gift ball that was found inside a Kurkure packet.
